units.source_text: 在做了这个梦两年之后，叔叔果然带我到了温泉浴场。

en.t: Two years after I had this dream, my uncle really did take me to the hot spring bathhouse.

units.source_text: 小路上的风景和梦中完全一样。

en.t: The scenery along the path was exactly the same as it had been in the dream.

units.source_text: 我在小路上看见了你的温泉浴场。

en.t: On that path I saw your hot spring bathhouse.

units.source_text: 那天早晨到这种地方来，是我有生以来头一遭，

en.t: Coming to a place like this that morning was the first time in my life,
I had never even seen such a place before.
